title: 43 Procreate Oil Pastel Texture Brush
author: Luna y Mar Studios
description:
Elevate your digital art with this 35 Procreate oil pastel texture brush set, crafted from real oil pastels for an authentic, hand-drawn look.
 This collection also includes 8 textured stamps, perfect for adding depth and dimension to your designs. Ideal for a wide range of projects, from fine art illustrations to modern graphic design, these brushes bring the rich, layered feel of traditional oil pastels to your iPad.
Each brush captures the unique texture and vibrancy of genuine oil pastels, offering a realistic and versatile toolset for your creative needs. Whether you’re looking to create blended backgrounds, textured illustrations, or bold strokes, these brushes deliver stunning results that mimic real-life materials.
Key Features:
35 Procreate brushes with realistic oil pastel textures
8 additional textured stamps for added depth
Perfect for fine art, illustrations, posters, and graphic design projects
Digitally crafted from real oil pastel textures for authenticity
Easy to use and fully customizable
Add a touch of texture and artistic flair to your digital artwork with this must-have Procreate brush set. 🎨✨
